ios.desc:
Transform your iPhone and iPad into a powerful editing suite with Darkroom, the award-winning photo and video editor designed for both aspiring photographers and professional creators. With desktop-quality tools at your fingertips, Darkroom rivals Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop — delivering a pro editing experience right on your mobile device.

Award-Winning Recognition:

Apple Editor's Choice since 2018
Apple Design Award Winner 2020
App Store Best New App 2015

Why Choose Darkroom?

Advanced AI-Powered Editing: Harness cutting-edge AI tools for precise, depth-based edits and intelligent object detection. Enhance skies, skin tones, and landscapes with unmatched accuracy — or let AI-powered presets analyze your photo and optimize color and exposure in one tap.

Professional Color Grading & Video: From 4K video color grading to film-inspired LUT presets, Darkroom gives you full creative control. Professional curves, selective color adjustments, and batch photo editing make every project effortless — whether you're retouching a single portrait or editing an entire shoot.

RAW & ProRAW Support: Import and edit RAW and Apple ProRAW files at full fidelity. Every edit is non-destructive, so you can undo any adjustment at any time. Darkroom works directly with your Apple Photos library — no importing, no exporting, no friction.

Professional Tools for Every Creator:

All-Inclusive Format Support: From RAW files to JPEG and HEIF, Darkroom provides powerful editing tools that ensure top-tier output across every photo and video format.

Built for iPhone Photographers: With deep iOS integration — Shortcuts, widgets, iCloud sync, and seamless Apple Photos access — Darkroom stands out as the premier editing tool for mobile photographers. A fast, gesture-driven interface makes pro editing feel effortless.

Praise from Experts:

"Darkroom is one of the best apps around, offering extensive support for RAW and ProRAW photos and capabilities to batch edit photos with ease." — The Verge

"Its iPhone-specific features make Darkroom the leading editing app for iPhone photographers." — The Sweet Setup

Seamless Organization and Sharing:

Organize your photos and videos with Darkroom's advanced management tools. Create collages, manage hashtag sets, and share your work effortlessly. Flag, reject, and cull your shoots before editing — then export in any format, all without leaving the app.
